call_purpose: Your custom domain had been showing "site can't be reached" for three days, while your funnel worked on the FlexiFunnels link but not on your own domain.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you deleted the old A record and added a CNAME record for "shop" with the target value from your FlexiFunnels domain settings, and your domain loaded; you then replaced the second "www" record with a CNAME record for "www" using the same target value, and you confirmed both versions now load your funnel.

covered.text: We explained that your old A record for "shop", pointing to an old server address, was blocking the connection.
We explained that the www version still showed an error because a second record for "www" pointed somewhere else.
The padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after connecting.

support_next_steps.text: We will check that your secure certificate has been issued, and we will message you if it has not.
